page.layout: One printed page (right-hand page of the opening). Running head at top centre; page number top right; one main text column; a marginal note at the right margin (Matth. 5.11-12 reference); a signature mark "N 2" at the foot; catchword "tume-" at the lower right.

main_text.p: tate destituaris, de vestra doctrina desperantem ad contumeliam & mendacia prorumpere. Itaque non solùm nos consolatur Christi sententia, Beati eritis quum conuitiati fuerint vobis, & persecuti fuerint, & dixerint quiduis mali, aduersus vos, mentientes propter me: sed magno nobis etiam gaudio est, quod vel Matth. 5.11. 12. tuo indicio ex hac maledicendi improbitate rem vestram ad triarios redijsse, & exitio proximam videamus. Si quid verò à nobis aduersus vestrorum hominum mores grauius dicatur, non illud maledicendi, sed arrogantiæ vestræ reprimendæ studio contingit: nec de paucis doctoribus, aut eorum qui admentem redierunt, peccatis sermo est: sed de plerisque Pontificibus, Cardinalibus, episcopis, sacerdotibus, monachis: quorum effrænem & minimè Christianam viuendi licentiā, nō ex nostrorum hominū, aut aliorum, qui vobis aduersantur, scriptis, aut rumoribus carpimus, sed ex consignatis veterū & recentiū pontificiorū Regum, Principum, & theologorum fide dignorum querelis, accusamus. Adeò vt non iniquæ con-tume-

page.notes: Marginal note at right reads "Matth. 5.11. 12." Left margin shows fragments of a neighbouring page (show-through) and was not transcribed. Some words in the text are faint: "triarios" and "admentem" may be misprints for other readings; "Adeò" and "non" read as printed.
